content.content: A bracket settles the working copy once before it opens its window, and both head reads observe the op log without snapshotting or updating the working copy; the window holds only the entries the operation created.
content.rationale: Every jj command snapshots the working copy before it reads, and a snapshot is an operation. Run inside the bracket, such a snapshot is an entry in the run window — an operation the invocation did not perform — so undo would revert the read instead of the work. Settling once before the window opens puts that snapshot outside it, and the head reads leaving the working copy alone keeps the close read from adding another; the window then holds only the operation's own entries. The read is S3-oplog's (ukrxptzm) and the bracketing S5-bracket's (otmxqplr); this leaf fixes only what the reads may do to the working copy, not the read or the protocol.
